statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail is at the upper watch band during the confirmed holiday halt; no current NQ price path is available to establish persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The next structural checkpoint is the 22:00 UTC reopen, where gap repair versus repeated extension determines whether Tail remains watch or becomes elevated.
headline: Holiday halt lifts Tail to upper WATCH; reopen gap repair is the next structural checkpoint
body: A delayed NQ quote captured near the assessment cutoff showed 29,593 (+0.09%), but the scheduled Labor Day halt means it is not evidence of post-halt matching. Brent remained near $97.5 and renewed U.S.-Iran maritime escalation kept Stress extreme.

outlookSummary: Tail is upper WATCH through the holiday halt. The main conditional risk window is the 22:00 UTC reopen through early post-reopen price discovery; Tail becomes elevated only if a gap resists repair and shallow or failed retracements develop into repeated extension.

forecastDetail.comment: The halt is observed; absent current matching, upper-WATCH Tail reflects gap/headline risk rather than a verified no-retracement path.
Closure preserves gap risk, but without NQ price discovery no persistent mean-reversion failure can be observed.
Oil and Gulf escalation keep Stress extreme; Tail remains WATCH because the NQ path is still unobserved during closure.
With two hours to reopen, accumulated imbalance is a checkpoint rather than evidence that a one-way price path has already formed.
The final pre-reopen hour stays upper WATCH; gap repair versus repeated extension is the next structural test.
At reopen, elevated Tail is conditional on an unrepaired gap plus shallow/failed retracements and repeated extension.
